basis: The minimum standard per role (#1426): automatic selection never chooses a model this table does not list for the role. An entry is qualified by AutoCode's own runs (a shipped default route, or a live qualification profile in scenarios/harness/profiles.py); a public benchmark admits a model only provisionally until such a run confirms it, and selection treats both alike until then. Every entry names its evidence. Routes list the spellings the tools record for the same weights, so one entry covers every tool that serves the model. Updated by pull request, like the price table.
